Parks and Recreation is now considered one of the greatest sitcoms ever made, but it almost didn't make it past its first season. From low ratings to an uncertain identity, Parks and Rec was on the verge of becoming another forgotten NBC comedy. Instead, it pulled off one of the most impressive turnarounds in television history.

Today, we're breaking down how Parks and Recreation saved itself.
